ed885645dad7d4f11e5589f4a326465ca3327c43.summary: Report on the 2022 ransomware attack on Suffolk County, which disabled its 911 system and other services. The attack is linked to the group known as ALPHV or BlackCat, which claimed responsibility, shared proof of access, posted screencaps of backup infrastructure and claimed 400 GB of county and contractor data. The publisher could not confirm the leak. The group's admin said backups should have been removed. The county reported spending $6.5 million on cybersecurity since 2019.
